name: CALL THE ATTACK
text: A free gambit of the Ironhorn: it names a Fellgor Ravager within 6 inches, and that operative and the Fellgor Ravagers within 2 inches of it may each take a free Dash.

name: VIOLENT TEMPERAMENT
text: This turning point, when a friendly Fellgor Ravager fights or retaliates, after its attack dice are rolled you may re-roll all of them (dice already re-rolled or replaced stay as they are).

name: AMBUSH
text: This turning point, a friendly Fellgor Ravager that changes from Conceal to Engage when activated is ambushing for that activation: when it fights, one of its normal successes is retained as a critical success. A frenzied operative cannot ambush.

name: PELTING FIREPOWER
text: This turning point, a Fellgor Ravager shooting an enemy another Fellgor Ravager has already shot has Ceaseless on its ranged weapons; if two or more others have, it has Relentless instead.

name: RECKLESS DETERMINATION
text: This turning point, when an enemy shoots an expended friendly Fellgor Ravager that cannot retain any cover saves, one of its defence dice is retained as a normal success without being rolled.

name: RUTHLESS RAMPAGE
text: After a friendly Fellgor Ravager takes the Fight action and is no longer in an enemy control range, it may at once take a free Charge of up to 3 inches, even if it already charged this activation.

name: WILD RAGE
text: When a friendly Fellgor Ravager is activated, its Move is 1 inch higher until the end of that activation.

name: ANIMALISTIC FURY
text: When a friendly Fellgor Ravager fighting or retaliating has a critical success after the dice are rolled, its first critical strike deals 1 extra damage.

name: BLOODSENSE
text: During a friendly Fellgor Ravager's activation, when it incapacitates an enemy in its control range, pick another ready friendly Fellgor Ravager within 3 inches of that enemy: when the first is expended, you activate the picked one next.
